notes.title: Patch 1.1 is Here!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we are happy to bring you some improvements and fixes.
During the last few weeks we have been listening to your feedback and worked in order to improve our game, hopefully making it even better! ^^
Here are the patch notes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39069965/88c599a7e792aa577645e52afddb7ac8e879d175.jpg

- Improved the number of dynamic expression for each girl
- Expressions don't overlap anymore if the player connect dots too quickly.
- You can now adjust the voice volume in the menu-> options section.
- Fixed some bugs concerning the wardrobe section
- Adjusted the Main menu music volume + music switch correctly when completing a level

We will do our best to add additional levels with the next update! In the mean time, thanks for the support and keep letting us know what do you think about our game!
